# Jose Excavation LLC

> Excavation and foundation contractor based in Milford, Massachusetts, working on urban and suburban sites up to 50 miles away (Milford area, MetroWest, Worcester County and the Blackstone Valley, Greater Boston). Bulk excavation, grading and trenching, basement construction, footings, frost walls, foundation retaining walls and rebar reinforcement for residential and commercial builds. Structural work only: no flatwork, driveways, patios or slabs.

- Base: Milford, MA 01757 (service area business, no public street address)
- Phone: (978) 401-8390
- Email: joseexcavationoffice@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM
- Owner: Jose Carlos de Oliveira, 25 years of hands-on excavation and foundation experience
- Licensed and insured for structural work in Massachusetts
- Can run several excavation sites at once for investors and builders
- The site evaluation is free

## Services

- Excavation & site preparation: grading, trenching and bulk excavation with heavy equipment
- Basement construction: excavation and structural perimeter for deep basements in custom homes, additions and commercial properties
- Footings, frost walls & foundation retaining walls: built to Massachusetts code, below the 4-foot frost line
- Rebar & structural reinforcement: cut, bent and tied to engineering specifications

## Regions served

- Milford and next door: Milford, Medway, Bellingham, Franklin
- Blackstone Valley: Hopedale, Mendon, Upton, Uxbridge, Northbridge
- MetroWest: Hopkinton, Holliston, Framingham, Natick, Ashland, Marlborough, Southborough, Westborough, Sudbury, Wellesley
- Worcester County: Worcester, Shrewsbury, Grafton
- Greater Boston: Newton, Needham, Norwood, Walpole, Boston
